## About me

<img src="images/profile.jpeg"
     alt="Hadrien Oliveri"
     style="width: 120px; height: 120px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; float: left; margin-right: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">

I am an applied mathematician working at the interface of nonlinear mechanics, elasticity, growth, and biological morphogenesis.

My research develops mathematical models for how biological and soft material systems grow, deform, and control their shape.

<!-- I am now a permanent [CNRS](https://www.cnrs.fr/en) Research fellow (*Chargé de recherche*) at the [*Institut Universitaire des Systèmes Thermiques Industriels*](https://iusti.cnrs.fr/?doing_wp_cron=1780647092.3494300842285156250000) ([*SOFT*](https://iusti.cnrs.fr/research/11948-2/) group) in Marseille, France.
 -->

I am currently a Group Leader at the [Max Planck Institute for Plant Breeding Research](https://www.mpipz.mpg.de/en), Cologne, Germany.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const track = document.querySelector(".news-track");
  const items = document.querySelectorAll(".news-item");
  const previous = document.getElementById("news-prev");
  const next = document.getElementById("news-next");

  if (!track || !items.length || !previous || !next) return;

  let current = 0;

  function showNews(index) {
    current = (index + items.length) % items.length;
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${current * 100}%)`;
  }

  previous.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    showNews(current - 1);
  });

  next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    showNews(current + 1);
  });
});
</script>
